messages:
zoe-finance: Heads-up — Lumen Edge (acct LE-210) charge for INV-2026-157 ($31,200) was flagged by the processor as disputed / debit hold. We have a hold on settlement. Notified acct team. @diego-am @marc-cs

marc-cs: Client says their bank put a debit hold due to an internal spend review. They asked if we can temporarily provision a reduced Dedicated footprint while they sort payment.

diego-am: Received an email from client finance: theyre willing to put $10k as interim escrow and want service unchanged. Also asked for waiver of NSF/late penalties during review.

anjali-collections: We can accept escrow but need signed agreement + POP. Collections policy: escrow accepted if >= 30% invoice and cleared within 48h. Waiver needs VP approval. If escrow not cleared, we flag for suspension after 5 business days.

viv-ops: Technical note: we can throttle non-critical pipelines and keep customer-facing endpoints live. Need explicit AM approval to alter resource allocations.

payment-gateway-bot: Alert: Settlement attempt failed: ACH return code R07 (authorization revoked) at 2026-04-08T14:12:03Z. Funds not posted.

zoe-finance: Ok — proposed path: ask client for immediate $10k wire + signed escrow amendment, set short-term throttle rule, and request card on file as fallback. If wire clears, we hold suspension and review fees.

marc-cs: Client says they can wire $10k today and provide SWIFT. I'll request card on file too. Theyre adamant no service disruption.

vp-finance: Waiver of NSF/late fee approved conditionally: only if $10k escrow posts and executed amendment returned within 72 hours. No blanket waivers. Finance to confirm cleared funds then remove fees.

anjali-collections: I'll prepare amendment wording: escrow amount, schedule for remaining balance, suspension triggers, and collections escalation timeline. Need AM and client CFO signatures.

diego-am: I'll coordinate signatures. Also confirm they accept throttle plan: reduce batch workers by 40% while preserving API SLA.

viv-ops: Plan: apply throttle tag "le-escrow-40" at 22:00 UTC after AM confirmation. Will monitor queue lengths.

zoe-finance: If wire posts, Ill mark INV-2026-157 as "escrow pending" then "on hold good" after clearing. Payment team — please confirm when funds settle.

payment-gateway-bot: Notice queued: next settlement retry scheduled 2026-04-09T06:00:00Z.

marc-cs: Client sent SWIFT remittance at 2026-04-08T16:03Z and signed PDF attached in email. Uploading now.

anjali-collections: Received signed amendment and remittance proof. Awaiting settlement. If cleared, we will not suspend and will remove late fees per VP directive.

zoe-finance: Closing loop: once treasury confirms cleared wire Ill update ledger and set service to normal. Thanks team.
